player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on DraftKings; primary execution/source expression: DraftKings.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on DraftKings; primary execution/source expression: DraftKings.

JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.

Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.

Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on DraftKings; primary execution/source expression: DraftKings.

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.

Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

payload.selection: Owen McCown Under 3.5 Player Pass Tds

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

form_reversion_guard.policy: Mean-reversion caution only; no claim that a player is 'due'. Fresh matchup/news evidence must justify overriding the guard. Missing analyst context never suppresses the POM; publication marks it with 🕵️.

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on DraftKings; primary execution/source expression: DraftKings.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on DraftKings; primary execution/source expression: DraftKings.

Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on DraftKings; primary execution/source expression: DraftKings.

Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on DraftKings; primary execution/source expression: DraftKings.

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.

Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
payload.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

payload.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
